title: Seweding Village, Mahikeng (village only, approx.): man, 37, dies in fight with girlfriend's brother, 17 Oct

story: SAPS says a 37-year-old man died in Seweding Village, Mmabatho, in the early hours of Saturday 17 October. Police called to a complaint at about 00:45 found his body, and paramedics declared him dead. Police say preliminary investigation indicates he jumped over a fence into a home and assaulted his girlfriend, and that her 47-year-old brother intervened; the confrontation between the two men led to his death. Police have not said how he died. SABC, quoting spokesperson Adele Myburgh, says the suspect has been arrested and is expected in the Mmabatho Magistrate's Court. Accounts differ on the day: SABC says Sunday; the police statement says Saturday 17 October.
incident: Sat 17 Oct 2026, early hours; police found him dead at about 00:45 (SAPS). SABC says Sunday
